title: Linked List Cycle
constraints: pos is -1 or a valid zero-based node index; an empty list uses pos = -1
inputFormat:
Implement linkedListCycle(head). Inputs below show JavaScript function arguments; there is no stdin parsing.
headFixture is [values, pos]; the tail links to the zero-based pos, or null when pos is -1. The function receives only the head.
outputFormat: Return true if following next pointers revisits the same node object; otherwise return false.

visuals.title: A cycle follows links, not repeated values
visuals.caption: For [[3,2,0,-4],1], the last node links back to index 1. Following next visits 2 → 0 → −4 → 2 repeatedly.
